hypothesis.title: The Turn-of-the-Month Effect in the US Stock Index, 2016--2026
hypothesis.statement: S&P 500 returns are higher on the last session of the month and the first three sessions of the next month.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: Mean daily S&P 500 return on turn-of-month sessions equals the mean on other sessions.
hypothesis.alt_hypothesis: The turn-of-month mean is larger (one-sided placebo p < 0.05).
hypothesis.methodology: Calendar-window placebo test with 10,000 draws of non-window sessions
hypothesis.metric_name: mean daily return on turn-of-month sessions
hypothesis.summary_findings: ToM mean 0.069% vs placebo 0.055% over 476 sessions (p=0.3904).

metrics.title: The Turn-of-the-Month Effect in the US Stock Index, 2016--2026
